payload.body: JUST IN - Over 1,500 Passengers and crew aboard the "Ambition" cruise ship, banned from disembarking in Bordeaux, France, "as a precautionary measure," due to 49 people with gastrointestinal sickness, and one passenger dead - his cause of death to be established.
